name: @pospay/commissions-engine
description: The pure commissions engine — plan types, plan validation, period computation. One dependency: @pospay/domain. Runs in Node and the browser (ADR-0054)

scripts.test:node: node --input-type=module -e "import { computePeriod, validateCommissionPlan, validateWireCommissionPlan } from '@pospay/commissions-engine'; import { validateCommissionPlan as fromValidation, validateWireCommissionPlan as wireFromValidation } from '@pospay/commissions-engine/validation'; if (fromValidation !== validateCommissionPlan || wireFromValidation !== validateWireCommissionPlan || typeof computePeriod !== 'function' || typeof validateWireCommissionPlan !== 'function') process.exit(1); const validation = await import('@pospay/commissions-engine/validation'); if (validation.computePeriod !== undefined) process.exit(1); await import('@pospay/commissions-engine/dist/plan-validation.js').then(() => process.exit(1), () => undefined);"
